Prismic Life Holding Company on Monday announced an agreement with Prudential Financial (
) under which Prismic will reinsure about $5 billion of reserves backing USD-denominated Japanese whole life insurance policies originated by Prudential’s Japanese affiliates.
Prudential’s obligations to these policyholders will remain unchanged following the reinsurance arrangement, and Prudential will continue to administer the contracts.

The transaction expands Prismic’s growing reinsurance platform and builds on the existing relationship between Prismic and Prudential, including in-force and new business flow transactions now covering more than $22 billion of USD-denominated liabilities.

title: Prismic Life announces $5B reinsurance agreement with Prudential Financial
